# These files are NOT scanned by TruffleHog for secrets
# Patterns: glob-style

# Documentation
docs/
*.md
LICENSE

# Example files (intentionally have placeholder secrets)
.env.example
**/.env.example

# Test fixtures
**/test/fixtures/**
**/__tests__/fixtures/**

# Build artifacts
node_modules/
dist/
build/
.next/
.nuxt/

# Lock files (can contain hashes that look like secrets)
package-lock.json
yarn.lock
pnpm-lock.yaml

# Helm chart values (have placeholder passwords)
k8s/examples/
**/values.yaml
